data.one_liner: A BLoC design pattern implementation using reactive streams.
data.what_it_does: Helps implement the BLoC design pattern using reactive streams from RxDart. It separates business logic from the UI layer via event and state contracts, with support for zero-boilerplate generation.
use_when: You want to implement the BLoC pattern using RxDart reactive streams
You need a clear separation of events, states, and business logic
avoid_when: You prefer simpler state management solutions like Provider
You do not want to use reactive streams or RxDart
strengths: Strong decoupling of UI and business logic
Built-in result handling for loading and error states
weaknesses: Requires familiarity with RxDart and reactive programming
Requires code generation setup for optimal usage
data.setup_notes: Requires adding build_runner and rx_bloc_generator to dev_dependencies and running the code generator.

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want the standard BLoC library implementation without relying heavily on RxDart.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a compile-safe, provider-based state management approach instead of streams.
